messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Information Provision" as it appears in the following examples.
['WE LET YOU KNOW THAT WE HAVE SENT YOUR FULL COMPENSATION PAYMENT OF 1.500,000.00USD TO YOU THROUGH MONEY GRAM, YOU WILL BE RECEIVING 10.000.00USD PER DAY, NOW WE HAVE Sent THE FIRST PAYMENT TO YOU.', "Please find below 'Changes to your Terms and Conditions' which details changes that we have made to the terms and conditions and fees and charges that apply to your account.", 'Your membership has been canceled', 'We are currently engaged in online account maintenance, therefore access to your account is temporarily unavailable pending confirmation of your identity.', 'Your online account has been flagged due to too many logins attempts error, as a bank we strongly advise you to restore your account access by following the link below .', 'Due to some technical error, we found that your account has been accessed from unknown destination which made your account inactive', 'To protect your account, we automatically suspended your online access.', 'Your HSBC Account security validation has expired, this maybe as a result of wrong or incomplete data entered during the last update.', 'It has come to our attention that your account has been flagged due to excessive login attempts from the Republic of Bhutan.', 'We suspected someone other than you with IP 221.130.162.205 trying to access your Personal Account.', 'We reviewed your account, and suspected that your Barclays account may have been violated from another IP.', 'Our record shows that you have a refund slated for your account due to charges made against your account by us.', 'Due to recent security issue, access to your online account is temporarily disabled until we hear from you.', 'Some Standard Bank customers have reported experiencing disconnect or write error issues with online banking.', 'Receipt Date: 19/11/14 Order Total: $2.28', 'This e-mail has been sent to you by NatWest to inform you that we were unable to process your most recent payment of bill.', 'We noticed your e-mail account has exceeded its limit, and you may not be able to send or receive messages,', 'We would like to notify you that NatWest bank carries out customer data verification procedure that is compulsory for all NatWest bank customers.', 'We would like to notify you that Lloyds carries out client details verification procedure that is compulsory for all our customers.', 'This to inform you that your access to our online banking service has been suspended.', 'We have therefore had to place a temporary hold on your Apple ID.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

content: {"summary": "We notify customers about account activity, security concerns, service disruptions, payment updates, policy changes, and required verification or actions."}
